notes.title: Fixed Bugs with Apple Detection, and Updated some fences
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where cow's apple above it's head was displaying if player picked up cow while holding an apple in their hand.
[*]Fixed bug where cow would not detect player's held apple if it was picked up while walking towards an apple.
[*]Lined up fences on levels 18, 23, and 25.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*]Fixed bug where cow's apple above it's head was displaying if player picked up cow while holding an apple in their hand.
[*]Fixed bug where cow would not detect player's held apple if it was picked up while walking towards an apple.
